g.text: Development view - deploy, production data and keepalive pipelines (.github/workflows/deploy.yml, prod-data.yml, keepalive.yml)
Deploy · after green CI on a push to main · ubuntu-latest
and with the commit of the CI run
calls the Render deploy hook for this commit
Waits for 200 on the API's /health (up to 6 minutes)
smoke: the site and the API answer 200
Keepalive · Mondays and Thursdays 07:23 UTC, and manual · ubuntu-latest
Cache-Control: no-cache, up to 130 s per request
If it fails, retries every 20 s for about 5 minutes
HTTP 200 with a JSON body = the database answered
(goes through the Vercel rewrite and wakes the API on Render)
deploy.yml and prod-data.yml share the concurrency group "deploy"
(they never run at the same time, without cancelling the one running)
